comments: COMMENT ON TABLE "napi_entities"."accounts" IS 'Accounts'' native schema'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "napi_entities"."accounts"."display name" IS 'The user''s display name'
app.Account.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."accounts" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "display name" varchar NOT NULL, "note" varchar, "version" integer NOT NULL, "mood" napi_entities.mood NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )

app.Membership.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."memberships" ( "account_id" integer NOT NULL, "team" varchar NOT NULL, "role" varchar NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk-memberships" PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "team") )

app.Note.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."notes" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "account_id" integer NOT NULL, "body" varchar NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "fk-notes-account_id" FOREIGN KEY ("account_id") REFERENCES "napi_entities"."accounts" ("id") )

app.Parcel.table: CREATE TABLE "napi_entities"."parcels" ( "id" integer NOT NULL, "qty" napi_entities.quantity NOT NULL, "mood" napi_entities.temper NOT NULL, "codes" napi_entities.code[] NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id") )
